description: This is a PHP class 'Conf' that encapsulates configuration details for database connection parameters such as host, port, database name, user, and password. It constructs these parameters based on environment variables and template placeholders, and provides getter methods to access each configuration value.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: A class that manages database connection configuration including host, port, name, user, and password, with constructor logic for environment-specific database naming and getter methods for each property.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database configuration properties from template placeholders and environment conditions.
